attributes.description: C compiler for Z80 CPU implemented in ES2025 Node.js
Intermediate representation used to compile C source to Z80 assembly
Extensible architecture via interfaces in src/plugins/interfaces.js with globalRegistry.register
Each compilation phase is a pass that transforms IR with .run(ir) method
All AST nodes have .toJSON() for inspectable output used for debugging and analysis
Parser combinator framework with seq, alt, many, some, opt, lit, any, pred, lazy, map combinators
Z80 has no 16-bit arithmetic, stack grows downward, accumulator A, HL for 16-bit addresses
8-bit accumulator A, registers B C D E H L, HL pair for 16-bit, IX/IY index registers, SP for stack
compiler.js integrates lexer → parser → AST → IR → optimization → codegen
VCC80O magic header with serialization of sections, symbols, relocations in src/linker/objectfile_loader.js
src/linker/linker.js combines object files, resolves symbols/relocations, generates binary/WLA DX output
src/linker/wladxcodegen.js generates WLA DX-compatible Z80 assembly with section directives and relocation support
src/linker/archive.js with Archive/ArchiveMember classes and VCC80A binary format
Dead code elimination, constant folding, redundant move/jump elimination, stack op merging
Physical Z80 register assignment with spilling and cross-block virtual register tracking
Supports void, char, short, long, unsigned, signed, _Bool with two-pass parsing and TypeSpecNode
IntrinsicInstruction IR class with intrinsic detection in translateCall and Z80 codegen for special opcodes
1-7 functions per file, JSDoc required, ES modules only
node:test runner, src/tests/*.test.js, describe/it organization, strict assertions only
Parser extensions, optimization passes, attributes handling, backend copying for new architectures
